# Meridian water system

The fictional Meridian water system uses three reservoirs with a combined
storage capacity of 72 million liters. The largest reservoir, Meridian East,
holds 40 million liters. Ultraviolet light is the primary disinfection method;
the fixture does not describe chlorine as the primary treatment. Water quality
samples are taken every 4 hours. A drought advisory begins when combined
storage falls below 35 percent. Reclaimed process water from Meridian supplies
irrigation to the Nova greenhouse. The Quartz microgrid exports surplus power
to Meridian's pumping station. No household medical or drinking-water dosage
advice belongs in this corpus, and it does not state water tariffs.
